display.purpose: Page titles, POS totals, builder headers (Fraunces / Cairo).

motion.name: control-transition
motion.value: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid Boutique Ink CTA for primary till and form actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1c1917; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-family: "DM Sans", Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #292524; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b0894a 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Idle payment/channel toggles and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: #1c1917; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 8px; font-family: "DM Sans", Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #fafaf9; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b0894a 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Default form and POS inputs with brass-tinted focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: "DM Sans", Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #78716c; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid #d6d3d1; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #1c1917; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: "DM Sans", Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, #b0894a 40%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White content surface on Shop Paper with soft rest shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #1c1917; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: Fraunces, Cairo, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-body { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: "DM Sans", Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #57534e; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav
components.description: Ink sidebar with brass-tinted active item.
components.html:
Scent Pro
New saleSales history
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 256px; background: #1c1917; color: #e7e5e4; padding: 24px 20px; font-family: "DM Sans", Cairo, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { font-family: Fraunces, Cairo, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-brand span { color: #b0894a; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #d6d3d1; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #b0894a 20%, transparent); color: #d4b483; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter used in POS builders; selected uses ink fill.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: "DM Sans", Cairo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; background: #fff; color: #1c1917; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-on { background: #1c1917; color: #fff; border-color: #1c1917; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, #b0894a 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: BrandName
components.css: .ds-brandname { font-family: Fraunces, Cairo, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1c1917; } .ds-brandname span { color: #b0894a; }

narrative.overview:
Scent Pro’s interface should feel like a refined perfume boutique counter that also runs a serious retail operating system: warm shop paper, ink as authority, and brass reserved for brand and wayfinding. Density stays till-first — scanable tables, large POS taps, obvious primary actions — while serif display moments (page titles, totals, builder headers) carry restrained luxury without slowing the cashier.

The system is bilingual: English uses Fraunces + DM Sans; Arabic prefers Cairo while keeping the same hierarchy and roles. RTL is a first-class layout mode, not an afterthought. Per-tenant themes may recolor ink, brass, and paper; gold remains the canonical Scent Pro brand identity and the reference for documentation.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas with ink primary actions and brass accents
Serif for display/brand; sans for body/ops density
Flat-by-default surfaces; soft card shadow only
Till-first clarity: decisive selected states, large POS targets
Theme-swappable tokens with stable semantic roles

rules.name: The One Brass Rule
rules.body: Atelier Brass is for brand, links, focus, and selection hints — not large fills. Primary fills stay Boutique Ink (or theme ink).

rules.name: The Theme Swap Rule
rules.body: Gold is canonical. Tenant themes may remap the five CSS variables only. Component hierarchy, density, and UX behavior must not change.

rules.name: The Serif Moment Rule
rules.body: Serif is for brand and display totals/titles — not dense table body text.

rules.name: The Till Density Rule
rules.body: Prefer scannable lists and large tap targets on POS over decorative whitespace.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No glow stacks, glassmorphism, or decorative multi-layer shadows on ops surfaces.

rules.name: The Soft Counter Rule
rules.body: Prefer rounded-lg/2xl over sharp zero-radius or oversized capsules on primary buttons.

dos: Do use Boutique Ink for primary actions and Atelier Brass for brand/links/focus.
Do keep Fraunces for display titles and totals; DM Sans/Cairo for body and tables.
Do preserve RTL and Arabic Cairo overrides when locale is ar.
Do keep theme swaps limited to the five CSS variables; preserve roles and hierarchy.
Do make selected payment/channel/POS states visually obvious (ink fill or strong border).
donts: Don't use purple SaaS gradients, neon accents, or heavy glassmorphism.
Don't flood screens with brass fills — brass is accent, not the canvas.
Don't put serif on dense table cells or long body copy.
Don't invent a second layout language per theme; themes recolor, they don’t redesign.
Don't replace the Scent Pro wordmark/logo treatment without an explicit rebrand.
